description: This file defines the static class RequestContext in the Orleans.Runtime namespace, which manages request-specific contextual data propagating through the Orleans runtime. It provides methods for setting, getting, and removing context entries, handles reentrancy control, and tracks request-related information such as ReentrancyId.

classes.name: RequestContext
classes.description: A static class that manages request-specific contextual data within the Orleans runtime, supporting features like request propagation, reentrancy control, and context key-value storage.

classes.name: RequestContext.ReentrancySection
classes.description: A struct implementing IDisposable that manages the scope of call chain reentrancy management, updating the ReentrancyId accordingly.

methods.name: AllowCallChainReentrancy
methods.description: Allows reentrancy for subsequent calls before disposal, by generating or reusing a ReentrancyId.

methods.name: SuppressCallChainReentrancy
methods.description: Suppresses reentrancy for subsequent calls within the scope of the returned ReentrancySection.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the request context based on a key.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets or updates a key-value pair in the request context.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair from the request context.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all context data for the current request.
